meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the LBA Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget and refer the item to a future date for action.
votes.description: The LBA Board closed the public hearing on the Capital Projects Fund budget for FY2024-25, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the LBA and convene as the RDA.
votes.description: Procedural motion to end the Local Building Authority meeting and begin the Redevelopment Agency meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the RDA Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget and refer the item to a future date for action.
votes.description: The RDA Board closed the public hearing on the Redevelopment Agency's FY2024-25 budget and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the RDA and convene as the City Council.
votes.description: Procedural motion to end the Redevelopment Agency meeting and begin the Salt Lake City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of February 6, 2024, March 26, 2024, and May 7, 2024, as well as the formal meeting minutes of April 16, 2024.
votes.description: The Council approved multiple prior work session and formal meeting minutes as part of the opening ceremony.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on Title 18 Text Amendments and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed amendments to Titles 2, 5, 18, and 21A of the Salt Lake City Code updating building code references, enforcement appeals, and fines, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 40 of 2024 amending Title 21A regarding Planning and Historic Landmark Commission membership and Appeals Hearing Officer term limits.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance reducing minimum commissioner quorum requirements for the Planning Commission and Historic Landmark Commission and removing the two-term limit for the appeals hearing officer, with the City Recorder directed to publish as soon as possible.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items G3 through G11 (FY2024-25 budget ordinances) to a future agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the combined public hearing on nine FY2024-25 budget-related ordinances—including the City budget, Library Fund budget, tax levy, fee schedule, compensation plans, and MOU appropriations—and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 41 of 2024 amending the FY2024-25 final budget (Budget Amendment No. 5, Item A-5) for traffic control and safety improvements at 2200 West and 2100 North, and request Administration guidance on roundabout placement.
votes.description: The Council approved a $450,000 one-time transfer from the General Fund Balance to the CIP Fund for traffic safety improvements at the 2200 West and 2100 North intersection, and directed the Administration to recommend criteria for roundabout placement considering air quality and pedestrian traffic.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 42 of 2024 approving a $350,000 loan for Shades of Pale, Inc. from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: The Council approved a $350,000 EDLF loan to Shades of Pale, Inc., a local microbrewer, to support the creation of 10 new jobs and retention of 11 existing jobs at their facility at 1388 South 300 West.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda, including board appointments and reappointments for Karen Ferguson, Talula Pontuti, and Tiffini Porter.
votes.description: The Council approved the appointment of Karen Ferguson to the City and County Building Conservation and Use Committee and reappointments of Talula Pontuti to the Parks, Natural Lands, Urban Forestry, and Trails Advisory Board and Tiffini Porter to the Art Design Board.
